n1c589c6a89.summary: Share buybacks by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which supported the KOSPI last month, are set to end this month. Samsung's buyback rate exceeded 100% of plan and SK Hynix has secured over 76%.
n1c589c6a89.why: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are the two largest memory chipmakers and among the biggest weights in South Korea's KOSPI index. Their buybacks can offer support to share prices.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The report says the end of buybacks by two major index heavyweights may change the index's future market support.

nf5017c0c75.headline: Effects of Joining CPTPP: Manufacturing Up 3.7 Times in 5 Years, Agricultural Damage Up 1.6 Times
nf5017c0c75.summary: The South Korean government reanalyzed the economic effects of joining the CPTPP trade pact. It found manufacturing production ripple effects have grown 3.7 times and agricultural production declines have grown 1.6 times compared with 2021-2022 estimates.
nf5017c0c75.why: The CPTPP is a trans-Pacific trade agreement covering a large group of economies. Its tariff and market access terms shape trade flows for exporters and farm sectors.

n8d093760e9.headline: “I Thought I’d Go Crazy Without Samsung and SK Hynix”… Down as Much as 38% From Peak, Anxious Holding [World of Retail Investors]
n8d093760e9.summary: Some retail investors who bought large amounts of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares are down as much as 38% from their peak. An investment adviser recommended reducing holdings in both stocks in a YouTube broadcast.
n8d093760e9.why: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are leading South Korean chipmakers whose shares drive a large part of the KOSPI index.

nc29781a3b3.headline: “Redevelopment Used to Make Money”—Is That Old News? Expert: “Existing Prices Must Fall Significantly for Projects to Work”
nc29781a3b3.summary: An analysis suggests profits from redevelopment projects may shrink as construction and financing costs rise and contribution burdens grow. Existing prices would need to fall significantly for many projects to work, according to an expert.
nc29781a3b3.why: Redevelopment projects depend on construction costs, financing rates and property prices, which shape developer returns.

ne58ac930a5.headline: Rents hit record highs: in the city, prices come close to 1,000 euros for 70 square meters
ne58ac930a5.summary: Rents in Monza and Brianza reached record highs, with third-quarter prices rising 3.9%, well above the national average, and some flats nearing 1,000 euros for 70 square metres.
ne58ac930a5.why: Rental price trends reflect local housing demand and affect residential property returns and household inflation pressures.
